blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Omnimodal embeddings naturally involve both shared representations and modality-specific features across heterogeneous inputs. However, existing omnimodal embedding methods often rely on a single shared parameter space over mixed-modality data, limiting structural separation between universal and modality-specific representations. To address this, we propose Syn-Omni, a unified framework for structured omnimodal adaptation with modality specialization and controlled cross-modal collaboration. Specifically, we introduce Orthogonal Modality-Expert LoRA (OME-LoRA), which decomposes adaptation into a shared LoRA path for universal semantics and modality-expert LoRA paths for modality-aware specialization. Furthermore, Progressive Synergy Routing (PSR) enables experts to first establish modality-specific priors, then gradually interact with other modality-experts for cross-modal synergy. Evaluated across 81 diverse tasks spanning image, video, audio, and audiovisual modalities, Syn-Omni consistently outperforms omnimodal baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of structured specialization and cross-modal progressive collaboration.
blocks.zh: 嵌入模式自然涉及各种投入的共同表述和模式的具体特点。 然而,现有的全模式嵌入方法往往依赖于一个共享的参数空间而不是混合模式数据,限制了通用和特定模式代表之间的结构分离。 为了解决这一问题,我们提议建立Syn-Omni,一个统一框架,以便通过模式专业化和有控制的跨模式协作来进行结构化的全模式调整。 具体来说,我们引入了Orthogonal Modality-Expert LORA(OME-LORA),它将适应分解为通用语义的共享LORA路径和模式-专家LORA路径,用于模式-意识专业化. 此外,逐步协同运行(PSR)使专家能够首先确定特定模式的前科,然后逐步与其他模式专家互动,实现跨模式协同。 对81项涉及图像、视频、音频和视听模式的不同任务进行了评估,Syn-Omni的业绩始终高于所有模式基准,显示了结构化专业化和跨模式渐进合作的有效性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Omnimodal Large Language Models (Omni-MLLMs) have opened a new frontier toward unified understanding across modalities, including text, images, video, audio, and their composed inputs Xu et al. (2025a) . With these versatile foundations, recent studies Xiao et al. (2025) ; Chen et al. (2026) have successfully repurposed Omni-MLLMs into discriminative embedding models through contrastive fine-tuning Jiang et al. (2025) ; Meng et al. (2026) with LoRA Hu et al. (2022) , offering an efficient and scalable framework for unified embedding spaces across heterogeneous modalities.
blocks.zh: Omnimouty大型语言模型(Omni-MLLMs)开辟了一个新的前沿,实现不同模式的统一理解,包括文本、图像、视频、音频及其由徐等构成的投入(2025a)。 在这些多功能基础上,最近的研究有:萧等 (2025年);陈等 (2026年),通过对比性微调江等 (2025年);孟等 (2026年),与LORA Hu等 (2026年),成功将Omni-MLM重新定位为歧视性嵌入模型. (2022年),为不同模式的统一嵌入空间提供了一个高效而可扩展的框架.

We compare three contrastive embedding setups: (1) modality-specific models, each trained independently on a single modality using a shared LoRA, (2) Uni-Omni (baseline), trained on mixed-modality data using a single shared LoRA, and (3) Syn-Omni (Ours), which combines a shared adaptation path with modality-specialized expert paths. blocks.en: Despite their strong performance, existing omnimodal embedding methods largely rely on fully shared parameter adaptation over mixed-modality data. While such shared adaptation is effective in learning a unified representation space, it provides limited structural separation between modality-shared and modality-specific representations. Since different modalities exhibit both common semantic structures and distinct modality characteristics, a shared adaptation space may underutilize modality-aware specialization over the course of training.
blocks.zh: 尽管其性能很强,但现有的全模式嵌入方法在很大程度上依赖于完全共享的参数适应而不是混合模式数据。 虽然这种共同适应在学习统一代表空间方面是有效的,但模式共享和模式特定代表之间的结构分离有限。 由于不同模式既显示出共同的语义结构和独特的模式特点,共享的适应空间在培训过程中可能未充分利用模式----意识专业化。

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 1 , different omnimodal adaptation strategies exhibit complementary strengths. Modality-specific models effectively preserve modality-aware characteristics, but their isolated training restricts cross-modal interaction and limits generalization. In contrast, Uni-Omni , a baseline trained on mixed-modality data with a single shared LoRA, learns a unified embedding space that performs well on composed multimodal settings such as audiovisual tasks. However, such fully shared adaptation provides limited structural separation to model modality-specific characteristics, whereas completely isolated experts fail to leverage cross-modal synergy. These observations highlight the need for a structured omnimodal adaptation strategy that can jointly support a unified semantic foundation and modality-aware specialization while encouraging collaborative interactions within an omnimodal embedding space.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,不同的全方位适应战略具有互补性。 模式特定模式有效维护了模式意识特征,但其孤立的训练限制了跨模式互动,限制了通俗化. 与此相反,Uni-Omni作为单一共享LORA的混合模式数据培训的基线,学习了一种统一的嵌入空间,在诸如视听任务等由多种模式构成的环境下很好地运作。 然而,这种完全共享的适应提供了有限的结构分离,以适应模式特定特点的模型,而完全孤立的专家未能发挥跨模式的协同作用。 这些意见突出表明,需要制定结构化的全模式适应战略,以便联合支持统一的语义基础和模式意识专业化,同时鼓励在全模式嵌入空间内开展协作互动。

blocks.en: To this end, we propose Syn-Omni , a framework that structurally separates shared and modality-specialized expert paths while progressively enabling cross-modal collaboration. Our framework consists of two key components: Orthogonal Modality-Expert LoRA (OME-LoRA) and Progressive Synergy Routing (PSR). OME-LoRA separates adaptation into shared and modality-specific LoRA paths to capture both universal semantics and distinct characteristics. Complementing this, PSR gradually enables these isolated modality-experts to interact and establish cross-modal synergy during training. As shown in Fig. 1 , Syn-Omni consistently improves upon the unified baseline, showing improved gains on composed multimodal tasks such as audiovisual understanding.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们提议建立Syn-Omni框架,从结构上将共享的专家途径与模式专家途径分开,同时逐步促成跨模式合作。 我们的框架由两个关键组成部分组成:正交运动-专家LORA(OME-LORA)和进步协同跑道(PSR)。 OME-LORA将适应分为共享的和特定模式的LORA路径来捕捉通用语义和独特的特性. 作为补充,PSR逐渐使这些孤立的模式专家能够在培训期间进行互动并建立起跨模式的协同作用。 如图1所示,Syn-Omni在统一基线上不断改进,显示在视听理解等成文的多式联运任务上取得了更好的收益。

blocks.en: We extensively evaluate Syn-Omni across 81 diverse embedding tasks spanning image, video, audio, and audiovisual modalities, covering a broad range of task types including classification, retrieval, and QA. We show that Syn-Omni outperforms existing omnimodal embedding baselines while achieving more balanced performance across these diverse modality settings. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of structured specialization and progressive cross-modal collaboration for unified omnimodal representation learning.
blocks.zh: 我们广泛评价Syn-Omni在包括图像、视频、音频和视听模式在内的81个不同嵌入式任务中,涵盖广泛的任务类型,包括分类、检索和质量保证。 我们显示,Syn-Omni的绩效优于现有的全模式嵌入基线,同时在这些不同模式的设置中实现更平衡的业绩。 这些结果表明,结构化的专业化和逐步的跨模式合作对于统一所有模式的代表学习是有效的。

blocks.en: We summarize our contributions as follows: • We address the structural limitations of existing fully shared or entirely isolated omnimodal adaptation methods by presenting a unified framework that simultaneously balances robust semantic foundations and modality-aware specialization. • We propose Syn-Omni , which pairs structured shared-expert adaptation in OME-LoRA with progressive cross-modal collaboration in PSR, where experts first establish modality priors and then gradually interact with other modalities. • Syn-Omni is evaluated across 81 tasks in image, video, audio, and audiovisual modalities, with various task types. Results show that Syn-Omni improves baselines across diverse modalities.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献总结如下: 我们通过提出一个同时平衡稳健的语义基础和模式意识专业化的统一框架来解决现有完全共享或完全孤立的全模式适应方法的结构局限性。 我们建议Syn-Omni将OME-LORA结构化的共享专家适应与PSR的渐进跨模式合作结合起来,专家首先确定模式前科,然后逐步与其他模式互动。 • 对Syn-Omni进行图像、视频、音频和视听等81个任务的评价,并有各种任务类型。 结果显示,Syn-Omni改进了各种模式的基线。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Omnimodal Embeddings. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been repurposed into embedding models through contrastive fine-tuning. Early frameworks on vision-language models like E5-V Jiang et al. (2024) and VLM2Vec Jiang et al. (2025) pioneered this transition by applying LoRA Hu et al. (2022) to text-image retrieval. Covering broader modalities, GVE Guo et al. (2025) and VLM2Vec-V2 Meng et al. (2026) extended this paradigm to video, while AuroLA Xu et al. (2026) focused on audio-text retrieval. Furthermore, Omni-Embed-Nemotron Xu et al. (2025b) and WAVE Tang et al. (2026) enable any-to-any retrieval across text, image, audio, and video by leveraging large omnimodal backbones Xu et al. (2025a) . To further refine cross-modal alignment, methods such as LCO-Emb Xiao et al. (2025) and e5-omni Chen et al. (2026) introduce explicit calibration strategies, including language-centric refinement and modality-aware temperature scaling. While most existing approaches rely on fully-shared adaptation ( e.g . , a single LoRA layer) across modalities, we introduce a decoupled adaptation framework in the omnimodal setting.

blocks.en: Structured Adaptation. Several approaches explicitly separate parameters to encourage specialization. MoELoRA Luo et al. (2024) and MoDULA Ma et al. (2024b) instantiate task-level experts within LoRA, while a separate line imposes orthogonality on the internal subspaces of each adapter Zhang et al. (2023) ; Li et al. (2025) . Beyond architectural separation, LIMoE Mustafa et al. (2022) shows that emergent modality-specific experts require explicit control for stable training. DGL Wei et al. (2025) shows that aggressive fusion can suppress modality-specific learning, while MCA Wu et al. (2025a) reports shortcut behaviors induced by simple contrastive objectives. From an optimization perspective, Uni-X Hao et al. (2026) reveals the limitations of shared transformers across heterogeneous modalities. We adapt these ideas to omnimodal embedding learning, separating experts along the modality axis rather than the task axis and regularizing the shared-expert relation instead of each adapter’s internal subspace.

blocks.en: 3.2 Orthogonal Modality-Expert LoRA
blocks.zh: 3.2 矫形模式-专家LORA

blocks.en: The training of omnimodal embeddings involves heterogeneous modalities with different characteristics, yet typically relies on a single shared LoRA applied across all modalities. This motivates a more structured design to better organize shared and modality-specific adaptation. To this end, we propose Orthogonal Modality-Expert LoRA (OME-LoRA), which introduces a structured decomposition of shared and modality-expert LoRA paths.
blocks.zh: 对自制嵌入式的培训涉及具有不同特征的多种模式,但通常依赖于适用于所有模式的单一共享LORA。 这促使设计更加结构化,以便更好地组织共同的和针对具体模式的适应。 为此,我们提议采用Orthogonal Modality-Expert LORA(OME-LORA),引入共享和模式专家LORA路径的结构分解.

blocks.en: Parallel Shared-Expert LoRA. Inspired by the decoupling of universal and domain-specific knowledge in multi-task learning literature ( Ma et al., 2024b ) , we extend this foundation to the omnimodal setting to jointly model shared semantics and modality-specialized characteristics. Specifically, as shown in Fig. 2 (b), a shared LoRA path is consistently activated for all input modalities, while modality-expert LoRA paths are selectively engaged based on the modalities present in x m x_{m} . The routing weights w m w_{m} enable adaptive integration of modality-expert outputs. We defer the details of modality-aware specialization in modality-experts and the routing strategy for cross-modal synergy among experts to Sec. 3.3 .

blocks.en: 3.3 Progressive Synergy Routing
blocks.zh: 3.3 逐步协同路线

blocks.en: The interaction between modality-experts is governed by the routing weights w m w_{m} in Eq. 2 . While hard routing based on the modality indicator v m ​ o ​ d v^{mod} activates only the corresponding experts, it restricts cross-modal knowledge exchange across experts. In contrast, soft routing with a learnable router enables synergy, but it can blunt expert specialization if the experts lack sufficient modality-aware priors early on, as explored in Fig. 5 (left).
blocks.zh: 模式-专家之间的相互作用由Eq. 2中的路由权重(w m w_{m})来决定。 虽然基于模式指标v m o d v^{mod}的硬路由只激活相应的专家,但限制跨专家的跨模式知识交流. 与此相反,带可学习路由器的软路由可以产生协同效应,但如果专家早期缺乏足够的模式认识前科,则可以钝化专家专业化,如图5(左)所探讨.

blocks.en: To facilitate stable collaboration among experts, we propose Progressive Synergy Routing (PSR), allowing experts to first establish modality priors via hard routing and then progressively exchange complementary information across modalities with soft routing, as illustrated in Fig. 2 (c). In addition, the Synergy Margin Loss (SML) is designed to avoid excessive suppression of absent-modality experts, preserving expert interactions necessary for cross-modal synergy.
blocks.zh: 为了促进专家之间的稳定合作,我们提议逐步协同路线,使专家能够首先通过硬路线确定方式前科,然后逐步地在有软路线的各种方式之间交换补充信息,如图2(c)所示。 此外,协同边际损失(SML)旨在避免过度压制缺失模式专家,保持跨模式协同所需的专家互动.

Synergy Margin Loss. To encourage modality-aware specialization in the router, we introduce an auxiliary supervision that guides the soft routing activations 𝐯 R \mathbf{v}^{R} using the modality indicators v m ​ o ​ d {v}^{mod} . While Binary Cross-Entropy (BCE) could directly enforce modality-aligned routing, it tends to excessively suppress absent modalities, eliminating potentially useful interactions across experts.
To preserve such collaborative capacity while maintaining the dominance of input-relevant modalities, we propose a Synergy Margin Loss ℒ S ​ M ​ L \mathcal{L}_{SML} . As shown in Fig. 3 , unlike BCE, the proposed objective enforces relative preference rather than absolute suppression, allowing related experts to retain meaningful activations while preserving specialization.

blocks.en: 3.4 Training Strategy
blocks.zh: 3.4 培训战略

blocks.en: We train Syn-Omni in an end-to-end manner by integrating OME-LoRA into the backbone and optimize the model with a joint objective that combines contrastive learning and structural regularization.
blocks.zh: 我们通过将OME-LORA整合入骨干,优化模式,实现将对比性学习和结构规范化相结合的共同目标,对Syn-Omni进行端到端的训练.

blocks.en: Architectural Integration. Instead of standard LoRA layers, we deploy OME-LoRA throughout the backbone, where each module consists of a shared adaptation path, modality-experts, and a learnable router. Such learnable parameters are maintained independently at each layer.
blocks.zh: 建筑综合. 而不是标准的LORA层,我们在整个骨干中部署OME-LORA,其中每个模块由共享的适应路径,模式专家,以及可学习的路由器组成. 这种可学习的参数在每一层独立维持.

blocks.en: Joint Optimization. The overall training objective ℒ t ​ o ​ t ​ a ​ l \mathcal{L}_{total} combines the primary contrastive objective with the proposed structural regularization losses: ℒ t ​ o ​ t ​ a ​ l = ℒ c ​ o ​ n + λ o ​ r ​ t ​ h ​ o ​ ℒ o ​ r ​ t ​ h ​ o + λ S ​ M ​ L ​ ℒ S ​ M ​ L , \mathcal{L}_{total}=\mathcal{L}_{con}+\lambda_{ortho}\mathcal{L}_{ortho}+\lambda_{SML}\mathcal{L}_{SML}, (7) where λ o ​ r ​ t ​ h ​ o \lambda_{ortho} and λ S ​ M ​ L \lambda_{SML} control the strengths of the orthogonal penalty and Synergy Margin Loss, respectively. Crucially, both regularization terms ℒ o ​ r ​ t ​ h ​ o \mathcal{L}_{ortho} and ℒ S ​ M ​ L \mathcal{L}_{SML} are computed and averaged across all layers containing OME-LoRA modules.

blocks.en: 4 Experiment
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: Training Data. We curate an omnimodal data mixture of 1.12M samples spanning image, video, audio, and audiovisual modalities. The training mixture covers diverse tasks including retrieval, classification, and QA, with various modality compositions ranging from single-modality inputs to composed multimodal scenarios. Detailed dataset types and statistics are provided in Sec. A.1 .
blocks.zh: 培训数据。 我们管理着由1.12M样本组成的全方位数据混合物,包括图像、视频、音频和视听模式。 培训混合体包括各种任务,包括检索、分类和质量保证,其模式构成多种多样,从单一模式投入到构成的多模式设想。 详细数据集类型和统计数据见Sec.A.1。

blocks.en: Model Variants. We build our Syn-Omni framework on top of pretrained Qwen-2.5-Omni Xu et al. (2025a) and train both 3B and 7B scale variants. OME-LoRA modules are inserted into the LLM layers while keeping the remaining backbone parameters frozen. We additionally establish Uni-Omni as a controlled baseline trained with the same data and optimization settings, using only a single shared LoRA and contrastive objective.
blocks.zh: 示范变体。 我们在经过预先训练的Quen-2.5-Omni Xu 等(2025a)之上建造了我们的Syn-Omni框架,并训练了3B和7B两个规模变体. OME-LORA模块被插入到LLM层中,同时将剩余的主干参数冻结. 此外,我们还将Uni-Omni确定为经过相同数据和优化设置培训的控制基线,只使用一个共享的LORA和对比性目标。

blocks.en: Implementation Details. Images and videos are processed using the native resolution scaling strategy of Qwen-2.5-VL Bai et al. (2025) , while videos are uniformly sampled into 8 frames and audio signals are resampled to 16 kHz. Models are trained for 1 epoch using the AdamW Loshchilov and Hutter (2019) optimizer with a cosine learning rate schedule, a peak learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , a warmup ratio of 0.04, and a global batch size of 768. We employ GradCache Gao et al. (2021) to maintain a large global batch efficiently. For the contrastive loss, we use a temperature τ \tau of 0.02. Consistent with prior methods Jiang et al. (2025) , we pool on the EOS token position followed by L2 normalization to extract the final embeddings.
blocks.zh: 执行细节。 图像和视频使用Quen-2.5-VL Bai等(2025)的原生分辨率缩放策略进行处理,而视频则被统一取样为8帧,音频信号被再被复制到16kHz. 1个时代的模型通过亚当W·洛什奇洛夫和胡特(2019年)的优化器进行训练,并采用同位素学习率表,峰值学习率为10−4 10^{-4},热能比为0.04,全球分批规模为768. 我们雇用了GradCache Gao等人(2021年)来高效地维持一大批全球货物。 对于对比性损失,我们使用的温度为 0.02 。 与先前的方法Jiang et al.(2025)一致,我们聚集在EOS标志位置上,然后L2正常化取出最终嵌入.

blocks.en: For OME-LoRA, we set the rank of the shared adaptation path to 8 and each modality-expert rank to 4. We use a synergy margin γ \gamma of 0.2 and apply the proposed Progressive Synergy Routing (PSR) schedule with warmup and transition ratios of t warm = 0.1 t_{\text{warm}}=0.1 and t blend = 0.5 t_{\text{blend}}=0.5 , respectively. Additional implementation details and hyperparameter configurations are provided in Sec. B.1 .

blocks.en: Evaluation Setup. We evaluate our framework on an extensive omnimodal benchmark consisting of 81 tasks spanning image, video, audio, and audiovisual modalities. Each modality group covers multiple embedding-oriented meta-tasks, such as retrieval, classification, and QA. For image and video evaluations, we adopt the MMEB-v1 Jiang et al. (2025) and MMEB-v2 Meng et al. (2026) benchmarks, respectively, while further extending with additional audio and audiovisual benchmarks collected in this work. The complete evaluation dataset details are provided in Sec. A.2 .
blocks.zh: 评价设置. 我们以广泛的全方位基准评估我们的框架,其中包括81项涉及图像、视频、音频和视听模式的任务。 每个模式组涵盖多个面向嵌入的元任务,如检索,分类,以及质量保证等. 对于影像和视频评价,我们采用MMEB-v1 Jiang等(2025)和MMEB-v2 Meng等. (2026) 各项基准,同时进一步扩大这项工作收集的视听基准。 完整的评价数据集详情见Sec.A.2。

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare Syn-Omni against recent Omni-MLLM-based embedding models, including OmniEmbed-v0.1 Ma et al. (2025a) , Omni-Embed-Nemotron Xu et al. (2025b) , OmniEmbed-Multivent Zhan et al. (2025) , WAVE Tang et al. (2026) , LCO-Emb Xiao et al. (2025) , and e5-omni Chen et al. (2026) . For a fair evaluation, we use officially released checkpoints and perform all evaluations under the unified protocol.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较了Syn-Omni与最近的基于Omni-MLLM的嵌入模型,包括OmniEmbed-v0.1 Ma等 (2025a),Omni-Embed-Nembethron Xu等 (2025b),OmniEmbed-Multivent Zhan等人(2025年)、WAVE Tang等人(2026年)、LCO-Emb Xiao等人(2025年)和e5-omni 陈等 (2026). 为了进行公正的评价,我们使用正式释放的检查站,并根据统一协议进行所有评价。

blocks.en: Metrics. We use Hit@1 as the evaluation metric, measuring whether the ground-truth target is ranked at the top among candidates. We report both modality-specific average performance and the overall average score from a single run. The overall score is computed by averaging modality-specific scores, where each modality-specific score is obtained by averaging the corresponding meta-task scores. Here, each meta-task score is computed as the average of its associated benchmark scores. Detailed benchmark-level performance breakdowns are provided in Sec. C.4 .
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 我们用Hit@1作为评价的衡量标准,衡量地面真实目标是否在候选人中排在首位。 我们报告具体模式的平均业绩和一次运行的总平均分。 总体分数通过平均模式特定分数来计算,其中每个模式特定分数通过平均相应的元任务分数来得到. 在此,每个元任务分数按其相关基准分数的平均值来计算. 详细的基准一级业绩细目见Sec.C.4。

blocks.en: 4.1 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.1 主要成果

blocks.en: Overall Performance. In Tab. 1 , we compare our framework against recent Omni-MLLM embedding models. While some methods excel in specific modalities, such as LCO-Emb Xiao et al. (2025) on video tasks and e5-omni Chen et al. (2026) on image tasks, their strong performance is less consistent across modalities. In contrast, our contrastive baseline, Uni-Omni , trained with a modality-shared LoRA, already achieves strong performance across all modalities at both the 3B and 7B scales. Building upon this baseline, Syn-Omni reaches the best overall scores of 49.4% and 51.6%, respectively. These improvements over Uni-Omni are statistically significant across the 81 tasks in a paired t-test ( p = 0.0044 p=0.0044 and p = 0.0189 p=0.0189 ).
blocks.zh: 总体业绩。 在标签一中,我们比较我们的框架与最近的Omni-MLLM嵌入模型. 虽然某些方法在具体模式方面表现突出,例如LCO-Emb Xiao等人(2025年)在视频任务和e5-omni方面 陈等 (2026) 关于图像任务,他们的强效表现在各种模式之间不太一致. 对比之下,我们的对比基线Uni-Omni在模式共享的LORA训练下,已经在3B和7B两个尺度上在所有模式中都取得了强劲的业绩。 根据这一基线,Syn-Omni分别达到49.4%和51.6%的最佳总体分数。 与Uni-Omni相比,在一对T测试(p=0.0044p=0.0044和p=0.0189p=0.0189)的81项任务中,这些改进在统计上具有重大意义。

blocks.en: Modality-wise Analysis. Breaking down the gains by modality, Syn-Omni improves most on audio and audiovisual tasks ( + 2.5 % +2.5\% and + 3.0 % +3.0\% at the 3B scale), with more moderate margins on image and video. A similar pattern appears at the 7B scale, where e5-omni leads on image and video while Syn-Omni is stronger on audio and audiovisual tasks and attains a higher overall score. This yields more even coverage across all modalities.

Table 2: Component analysis of Syn-Omni framework. Starting from the Uni-Omni baseline in (a), each row incorporates individual components of our design. The results show that both OME-LoRA and PSR contribute to improved and balanced performance over the baseline, with the full model achieving the best overall results.
blocks.zh: 表2:Syn-Omni框架的组成部分分析。 从(a)中的Uni-Omni基线开始,每行包含我们设计的各个组成部分。 结果显示,OME-LORA和PSR都有助于在基线基础上改进和平衡业绩,而整个模型取得最佳的总体结果。

blocks.en: 4.2 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.2 读取研究

blocks.en: We conduct a series of ablation experiments to analyze the individual contribution of each proposed component in our Syn-Omni framework. All results are reported using 3B-scale models, including both modality-specific and overall averaged scores.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了一系列的消化试验,分析我们Syn-Omni框架中每个拟议组成部分的个别贡献。 所有结果均采用3B级模型报告,包括特定模式和总体平均分数。

blocks.en: Component Analysis. As shown in Tab. 2 , compared to Uni-Omni baseline in (a), introducing a shared-expert structure (S-Exp.) with hard routing in (b) improves performance through structural decomposition. Since hard routing activates experts in isolation and leaves limited interaction for shared-expert decorrelation, the orthogonal penalty alone in (c) yields no additional gain over (b). Soft routing alone in (d) likewise maintains a comparable level, as it lets experts interact before acquiring modality priors, which blunts specialization. When applying Progressive Synergy Routing (PSR) with Synergy Margin Loss (SML) in (e), further improvements are obtained. Under this configuration, the orthogonal penalty provides a complementary gain in (f) (49.0 → \rightarrow 49.4), indicating that reducing redundancy becomes effective once multiple expert outputs are jointly integrated.
blocks.zh: 构成部分分析。 如Tab. 2所示,与(a)中的Uni-Omni基线相比,采用了一种共享专家结构(S-Exp.),在(b)中采用硬通路,通过结构分解提高性能. 由于硬通路在孤立中激活了专家,对共享专家的装饰关系也留下了有限的交互作用,因此仅(c)中的正交处罚就不会产生超过(b)的额外收益. 单是(d)中的软路由同样保持了相当的水平,因为它让专家在获得模式前进行互动,这削弱了专业化。 在(e)中应用与协同边际损失(SML)的渐进协同运行(PSR)时,得到了进一步的改进. 在这种配置下,正交处罚在(f)项(49.0 ~\ightar 49.4)中提供了补充收益,表明一旦联合整合多种专家产出,减少冗余便生效。

blocks.en: Beyond these overall numbers, the components introduced on top of the shared-expert structure also shape how experts behave: they yield clearer separation across pathways, progressive participation of absent-modality experts, and routing activations that avoid collapsing to hard assignments, which we further analyze in Sec. 4.3 .
blocks.zh: 除了这些总数之外,在共享专家结构之上引入的组件也决定了专家的行为方式:它们可以更明确地区分出各种途径,使缺失模式专家逐步参与,以及可避免陷入难以完成的任务的路由激活,我们在第4.3节对此作了进一步分析。

blocks.en: Structural Efficiency. We explore the impact of different architectural choices under matched parameter budgets. As shown in Tab. 3 , simply increasing the rank of a single shared path from 16 to 36 brings only marginal gains, with the rank 24 counterpart in (b) even leading to a slight drop. In contrast, our OME-LoRA decomposes the same total rank (24) into shared and expert paths, which brings improvements at an identical parameter count (44.9M) in (f). Applying PSR on top of this structure in (g) further boosts performance to 49.4 % \% . Notably, this surpasses the largest shared-only variant in (c) while using fewer trainable parameters, confirming that the gains stem from structured decomposition rather than increased capacity.
blocks.zh: 结构效率。 我们在相应的参数预算下探索不同建筑选择的影响. 如塔布所显示. 3,简单地将单一共享路径的等级从16名提升到36名,只带来边际收益,(b)中的24名对应人员甚至导致略有下降. 相比之下,我们的OME-LORA将相同的总排名(24)分解为共享和专家路径,从而在(f)中一个相同的参数计数(44.9M)上带来了改进. 在(g)中将PSR应用在这个结构上进一步将性能提升到49.4% QQ. 值得注意的是,这超过了(c)中最大的共享唯一变体,同时使用了较少的可训练参数,证实收益来自结构分解而不是能力的增加。

blocks.en: Table 3: Analysis of the adaptation structure. ‘Shr’ denotes a single shared LoRA path ( Uni-Omni ) with increasing rank. ‘Exp’ denotes modality-expert paths without a shared LoRA path, and ‘Shr+Exp’ denotes our OME-LoRA architecture. Neither path alone is sufficient: scaling the shared path yields limited gains, and removing it degrades performance further.
blocks.zh: 表3:适应结构分析。 `Shr'表示一个共同的LORA路径(Uni-Omni), “Exp”表示模式-专家路径,没有共享的LORA路径,“Shr+Exp”表示我们的OME-LORA架构。 单靠两个途径都不够:扩大共享途径产生有限的收益,去除它会进一步降低性能。

blocks.en: Table 4: Analysis on Progressive Synergy Routing (PSR) strategy. We evaluate the impact of routing types, progressive blending, and router loss functions in the OME-LoRA layers. We highlight that combining a progressive blending of routing weights with the Synergy Margin Loss (SML) is crucial for both expert specialization and cross-modal collaboration among experts.
blocks.zh: 表4:关于逐步协同运行战略的分析。 我们评价OME-LORA层的路由类型、渐进混合和路由器丢失功能的影响。 我们强调,将路由权重与 " 协同边际损失 " (SML)逐步结合,对于专家专业化和专家间跨模式合作都是至关重要的。

blocks.en: Role of Shared LoRA. We next evaluate the necessity of the shared LoRA path within the OME-LoRA architecture. As shown in Tab. 3 , omitting the shared path leads to a substantial performance drop under both hard routing (f vs. d) and with PSR integrated (g vs. e) cases. More importantly, expert-only adaptation in (d) falls even below the shared-only baseline in (a) at the same parameter count (47.0 vs. 47.7 at 29.9M). This suggests that the shared path provides a unified cross-modal space on which experts build their specialization, and that establishing it matters more than allocating the same capacity to experts alone.
blocks.zh: 共享乐团的作用。 接下来,我们评价OME-LORA架构内共享LORA路径的必要性. 如Tab. 3所示,省略共享路径会导致在硬路由(f vs. d)和PSR集成(g vs. e)两种情况下出现大量性能下降. 更重要的是,(d)项中的专家适应甚至低于(a)项中同一参数的共享基准(47.0对47.7对29.9M)。 这表明,共同的道路为专家们提供了一种统一的跨模式空间,他们可以在此基础上建立自己的专业化,而建立这一道路比将同样的能力单独分配给专家更为重要。

blocks.en: Role of Progressive Synergy Routing. We further investigate the impact of our routing strategies, as summarized in Tab. 4 . Compared to the hard routing baseline in (a), switching to soft routing with BCE loss in (b) provides limited to no improvement. However, across both standard soft routing (b vs. c) and progressive blending configurations (d vs. e), replacing BCE with the Synergy Margin Loss (SML) consistently improves performance. Our final framework in (e), which integrates both progressive blending and SML, achieves the best overall performance of 49.4%. This demonstrates that the two components, progressive blending with synergy margin loss in PSR, complement each other to deliver the superior results.
blocks.zh: 进步协同路线的作用。 如Tab所总结的,我们进一步调查我们路线战略的影响。 4. 与(a)项的硬通路基线相比,(b)项改为软通路,但因BCE损失而不能改进。 然而,在标准软路由(b vs. c)和渐进混合配置(d vs. e)两个方面,以协同边际损失(SML)取代BCE,不断提高性能. 我们在(e)中的最后框架将逐步混合和SML结合起来,实现了49.4%的最佳总体业绩。 这表明,两个组成部分,即逐步与PSR中的协同系数损失相混合,相互补充,以取得优异的结果。

blocks.en: 4.3 Empirical Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 经验分析

blocks.en: To better understand how Syn-Omni structures omnimodal representations, we analyze the behaviors of its two key components, OME-LoRA and PSR, on VALOR-32k Liu et al. (2025) evaluation samples with text, video, and audio inputs. Results are computed from final-layer signals averaged across samples and submodules.
blocks.zh: 为了更好地了解Syn-Omni如何构建全方位表达,我们在VALOR-32k上分析其两个关键组件OME-LORA和PSR的行为. 刘等. (2025)有文字,视频,音频投入的评价样本. 计算结果的依据是样本和分模块的终端信号平均值。

blocks.en: Decoupling in OME-LoRA. As shown in Fig. 5 , we measure pairwise cosine similarity between the flattened hidden states of the shared pathway and modality-experts using text-video-audio inputs. Without applying progressive blending (left), relying solely on soft routing fails to induce clear separation, evidenced by high cross-path similarities both between the shared pathway and experts, and across experts. In contrast, Syn-Omni (right) produces substantially lower cross-path similarities, indicating clear modality specialization across paths in the OME-LoRA architecture.
blocks.zh: 在OME-LORA进行脱钩. 如图5所示,我们用文本视频-音频输入测量共享路径被平整的隐藏状态与模式-专家之间的对等共弦相似性。 不采用渐进式混合(左),仅仅依靠软通路无法导致明确的分离,这表现在共享通道与专家之间以及专家之间的高度交叉。 相形之下,Syn-Omni(右)产生的跨行道相似性要低得多,表明OME-LORA架构的跨行道有明显的模式专业化.

blocks.en: Routing Dynamics in PSR. We analyze the evolution of PSR routing weights under video-audio inputs to demonstrate the emergence of cross-modal interactions during training in Fig. 6 . Under progressive blending, present-modality experts (video and audio) maintain dominant routing weights. In contrast, absent-modality experts (text and image), initially suppressed to zero under hard routing scheme, gradually acquire non-zero weights by introducing soft routing scheme. This behavior demonstrates that PSR enables cross-modal collaboration while preserving modality specialization. We further observe that SML drives this synergistic behavior, whereas BCE loss completely suppresses absent-modality experts, as shown in Fig. 8 .
blocks.zh: 在PSR中运行动态. 我们分析视频-音频输入的PSR路由权重的演变,以显示在图6培训期间出现跨模式互动。 在渐进式混合下,即时模式专家(视频和音频)保持了主导路由权重. 相形之下,在硬路由方案下最初被压制为零的缺席模式专家(文字和图像)通过引入软路由方案而逐渐获得非零权重. 这种行为表明,PSR在保持模式专业化的同时,可以实现跨模式协作. 我们进一步注意到,SML推动这种协同行为,而BCE损失完全压制了缺模式专家,如图8所示。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We propose Syn-Omni , a structured omnimodal adaptation framework that effectively learns a unified representation space. It leverages OME-LoRA to decouple modality-shared and specialized parameters. In addition, Progressive Synergy Routing (PSR) shifts the model from isolated specialization toward dynamic cross-modal collaboration. Across 81 diverse tasks, Syn-Omni outperforms existing baselines, achieving robust and well-balanced performance across image, video, audio, and audiovisual modalities.
blocks.zh: 我们提议Syn-Omni,这是一个结构化的全方位适应框架,有效地学习了统一的表达空间。 它利用OME-LORA来解析模式共享和专用参数. 此外,进步协同路线(PSR)将模式从孤立的专业化转向动态的跨模式合作。 在81个不同的任务中,Syn-Omni的绩效超过了现有基线,在图像、视频、音频和视听模式方面都取得了强劲和平衡的业绩。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our framework introduces additional inference overhead through dynamic routing in the OME-LoRA layer. While standard LoRA weights can be merged into the frozen backbone after training, our input-dependent routing prevents this for the modality-experts, although the shared pathway remains mergeable. Specifically, the increased overhead due to the expert pathways active at inference amounts to 17–18 % \% higher latency with less than 1 % \% additional GPU memory, as reported in Tab. 7 . This cost is most visible in latency-sensitive settings such as real-time query encoding.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架通过OME-LORA地层的动态路由引入了额外的推论间接. 虽然标准LORA权重可以在训练后被合并到被冻结的骨干上,但我们的依赖输入的路由却阻止了模式-专家这样做,尽管共享路径仍然可以合并. 具体地说,如Tab所报道的,由于专家在推论中活跃的路径而增加的间接费用达到17-18 % 的较高延迟,加起来的GPU内存不到1%。 7,这一成本在即时查询编码等耐久敏感设置中最为明显.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Our framework may inherit systemic biases from large-scale training data, leading to skewed cross-modal retrieval behaviors. Additionally, such unified omnimodal embeddings could be misused for unauthorized surveillance or identity linkage, necessitating strict deployment oversight.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架可能继承大规模培训数据的系统性偏见,导致跨模式检索行为扭曲。 此外,这种统一的全模式嵌入可能被滥用于未经授权的监视或身份联系,因此需要严格部署监督。

blocks.en: A.2 Evaluation Datasets
blocks.zh: A.2 评价数据集

blocks.en: To construct our evaluation suite across four distinct modalities: image, video, audio, and audiovisual, we leverage and extend existing evaluation frameworks. Specifically, for the image and video tasks, we utilize the evaluation suites from MMEB-v1 Jiang et al. (2025) and MMEB-v2 Meng et al. (2026) , respectively. While MMEB-v2 natively includes text-to-video retrieval, it lacks the corresponding video-to-text direction. Therefore, we integrated video-to-text retrieval to ensure a bidirectional evaluation. Furthermore, we expand the benchmark’s scope by incorporating additional audio and audiovisual tasks.
blocks.zh: 为了在四种不同模式 -- -- 图像、视频、音频和视听 -- -- 建立我们的评价套件,我们利用和扩大现有的评价框架。 具体来说,在图像和视频任务方面,我们分别利用了MMEB-v1 Jiang等人(2025年)和MMEB-v2 Meng等人(2026年)的评价套件。 虽然MMEB-v2在本土包括了从文本到视频的检索,但它缺乏相应的视频到文本的方向. 因此,我们综合了视频到文本检索,以确保双向评价。 此外,我们扩大了基准范围,增加了视听任务。

blocks.en: The detailed statistics and configurations for each modality are provided from Tab. 12 to Tab. 15 , each specifying the task type, query-to-target composition, and data sizes. In these tables, the corpus size is defined differently based on the task type: it denotes the number of classes for classification (CLS) tasks, the number of choices for question answering (QA) tasks, and the actual database size for retrieval (RET) tasks. (2026) ; Chen et al. (2026) , left-padding is applied during batching.

blocks.en: B.2 Evaluation Pipeline
blocks.zh: B.2 评价管道

blocks.en: For a fair evaluation, previous methods are evaluated under the unified setting using the official checkpoints. We extend the VLM2Vec-V2 codebase used for evaluation Meng et al. (2026) , which enables the integrated evaluation of diverse modalities and task types while facilitating seamless modality expansion. While this evaluation framework originally supports image and video inputs, we extend it to encompass audio and audiovisual modalities also, thereby enabling an any-to-any query-to-target retrieval setting.
blocks.zh: 为了进行公平的评估,以前的方法是在使用官方检查站的统一环境下进行评估的。 我们扩展了用于评价Meng等人的VLM2Vec-V2编码库(2026年),从而能够综合评价各种模式和任务类型,同时促进无缝模式的扩展。 虽然这一评价框架最初支持图像和视频投入,但我们将其扩大到包括音频和视听模式,从而能够对任何查询进行检索。

blocks.en: The input processing for text, image, video, and audio modalities remains identical to those used during the training phase. For inference, standard LoRA adapter parameters are merged into the base pretrained weights, and such LoRA layers are not utilized any further. In contrast, for Syn-Omni , only the shared adaptation path is merged into the backbone weights and removed, whereas the expert paths are explicitly maintained to support dynamic routing during inference, where the soft routing weights generated by the router are utilized.
blocks.zh: 文本、图像、视频和音频方式的输入处理与培训阶段所用方式相同。 就推论而言,标准LORA适配参数被合并到基础预受训练重量中,这种LORA地层不再被再利用. 相比之下,对Syn-Omni来说,只有共享的适应路径被合并为骨干重并被去除,而专家路径则被明确维护,以支持推论期间的动态路由,即使用由路由器产生的软路由权重.

The baseline (BCE loss) exhibits a collapsed hard routing behavior with nearly binary activations, whereas ours (synergy margin loss) dynamically allocates routing weights even to absent-modality experts to encourage cross-modal synergy.

blocks.en: C.1 Routing Behavior across Layers
blocks.zh: C.1 跨层游走行为

blocks.en: Extending the analysis in Fig. 6 , we investigate how different router loss formulations affect routing dynamics at the layer level. While the main paper tracks routing weights across training steps, this section visualizes the layer-wise soft routing activations of the converged model using audiovisual, video-only, and audio-only inputs from VALOR-32k Liu et al. (2025) . Under this configuration, Fig. 8 compares the binary cross-entropy (BCE) loss against our synergy margin loss across the entire layer hierarchy.
blocks.zh: 扩展图6分析,我们调查不同路由器丢失配方如何影响地层的路由动态. 虽然主要纸张跟踪跨培训步骤的路由权重,但本节通过VALOR-32k的视听、视频和音频专用输入,可视化地对接的模型进行分层软路由激活。 刘等 (2025). 在这种配置下,图8将二进制跨内涵(BCE)损失与整个层层的协同系数损失进行比较.

blocks.en: As shown in the figure, BCE loss forces the router into strict modality classification based on the input type. Except for the first layer, this results in routing activations approaching 1 for present modalities and 0 for absent ones, collapsing into a deterministic hard routing behavior despite using a soft routing formulation. In contrast, our synergy margin loss maintains dominant activations for the input modalities while preserving meaningful activations even for absent modalities across all layers. This collaborative activation behavior across the layer hierarchy successfully facilitates cross-modal synergy, aligning with our architectural objectives.
blocks.zh: 如图所示,BCE损失迫使路由器根据输入类型进行严格的模式分类. 除第一层外,这导致目前模式的路由活化接近1个,而缺失模式为0个,尽管使用了软路由配方,但还是陷入了决定性的硬路由行为. 相比之下,我们的协同系数损失维持了输入模式的主要活化作用,同时保留有意义的活化作用,即使没有所有层面的模式也是如此。 这种跨层层次的合作激活行为成功地促进了跨模式的协同,与我们的建筑目标相配合.

blocks.en: Intriguingly, the image-specific model exhibits solid performance on video tasks, while the video-specific model retains reasonable results on both image and audiovisual tasks. These trends indicate that a unified training setting, where a model is exposed to diverse modalities, can induce cross-modal synergy. This serves as the primary motivation behind the design of our Orthogonal Modality-Expert LoRA (OME-LoRA) paired with the Progressive Synergy Routing (PSR) mechanism.
blocks.zh: 有趣的是,图像特异性模型在视频任务上表现出扎实的表现,而视频特异性模型在图像和视听任务上都保留了合理的结果. 这些趋势表明,一个统一的培训环境,如果一个模式能够接触到各种不同的模式,就可以产生跨模式的协同作用。 这成为设计我们的正统模式-专家LORA(OME-LORA)与进步协同运行机制相配合的主要动力。

blocks.en: While the Uni-Omni baseline exhibits performance comparable to or slightly lower than that of the respective modality-specific models in their native modalities, our Syn-Omni framework consistently delivers improved performance, demonstrating the effectiveness of cross-modal synergy.
blocks.zh: 虽然Uni-Omni基线显示的绩效可与各自模式的具体模式相比或略低,但我们的Syn-Omni框架不断提高绩效,显示了跨模式协同效应的有效性。

blocks.en: C.3 Runtime Analysis
blocks.zh: C.3 运行时间分析

blocks.en: To evaluate inference-time efficiency, we benchmark Uni-Omni and Syn-Omni on the VALOR-32k audiovisual input using a single NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU (batch size 1). As shown in Tab. 7 , Syn-Omni introduces a slight increase in both latency and memory across 3B and 7B scales. Specifically, for the 3B variant, the mean latency increases from 300.3 ms to 354.6 ms, while the peak GPU memory changes from 9612 MB to 9676 MB.
blocks.zh: 为了评价推断时间的效率,我们用一个单一的NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU(批量尺寸1)将Uni-Omni和Syn-Omni作为VALOR-32k视听输入的基准. 如塔布所显示. 7,Syn-Omni在3B和7B尺度上引入了耐用和内存都略有增加. 具体来说,对于3B变体,平均耐用从300.3 ms增加到354.6 ms,而最高峰的GPU内存从9612 MB变为9676 MB.

blocks.en: This overhead is due to architectural differences at inference time. In Uni-Omni , standard LoRA adapters are fully merged into the backbone weights, maintaining the original backbone’s inference path. In contrast, while Syn-Omni merges its shared adaptation path, it explicitly retains the four modality-specific expert paths and router parameters to support input-dependent routing.
blocks.zh: 这种间接费用是由于推断时间的建筑差异. 在Uni-Omni中,标准LORA适配器被完全合并入骨干重量,维持了原骨干推导路径. 相形之下,虽然Syn-Omni合并了其共享的适应路径,但它明确保留了四种模式特有的专家路径和路由参数,以支持依赖输入的路由.
